name: Can CG Plumbing Solutions convert my bathtub to a shower?

mainEntity.name: Can CG Plumbing Solutions convert my bathtub to a shower?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, CG Plumbing Solutions frequently performs bathtub-to-shower conversions. This involves removing the existing bathtub, modifying plumbing lines, and installing a new shower pan, walls, and fixtures. This conversion is a popular option for homeowners seeking improved accessibility or a more modern bathroom aesthetic. It often requires careful planning for water drainage and proper waterproofing to prevent future issues, which we meticulously manage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, CG Plumbing Solutions can convert bathtubs to showers, involving removal, plumbing modifications, and new fixture installation. This offers improved accessibility and modern aesthetics.
